There are a few outstanding things that I’d like to clarify.

At this point, the requested workload and revisions have clearly exceeded the original scope, so I cannot continue making changes under the existing terms.

To clarify what that scope was, our initial discussion covered image design only—not a full monthly hiring arrangement, which honestly is not suitable for me at this stage. We agreed on $360 for the work, equivalent to roughly $32 per image/page.

I have tried to remain cooperative and completed multiple requested changes. However, repeatedly requesting major redesigns while describing the work as “template-based” is not accurate: everything was properly created from scratch, and I retain all the original source files.

If you would like further revisions or additional work, the cost will need to be adjusted accordingly. Otherwise, no more changes can be made under the same terms. Thank you for understanding, and please let me know how you would like to proceed.

I have cooperated fully from my side, yet my concerns continue to be ignored.

Please understand my situation. I still have other work pending, and remaining stuck on this project will cause a significant loss of my time, effort, and mental focus. If this arrangement suits you, that is fine; if it does not, I kindly request that we wind up the project here.
